name: manual_7bc885
claim: When a retrieval system retires a superseded record wholesale, split a broad record before narrowly correcting it: keep each independent rule as focused active lessons, then retire the redundant aggregate and retain only the supersession-scope mechanism as distinct guidance.

decisions.notes: Replaces the aggregate duplicate with its unique supersession-scope rule; the concrete watcher, anti-hand-waving, and PR-locality guidance remains active in lessons 8c228d4bfa25, b85d462f63ae, and d1d4be1ab678.
